full_prompt_en: A square digital action illustration shows a masked fighter standing wide-legged amid smoke and sparks in a dark arena-like space. A broad conical hat shades the head, and the figure wears layered red cloth over black and charcoal armor. The face is almost entirely concealed beneath the hat brim, with only a narrow dark mask and faintly glowing eyes visible at the center. The torso is crossed by overlapping red panels, tied at the waist and hanging in long strips toward the knees. Armored shoulders and forearms extend outward, each hand holding a bright orange-white ball of fire. The circular flames sit near the left and right lower thirds, forming a strong pair of warm focal points around the central red figure. Legs are spread in a grounded fighting stance, with fabric and smoke obscuring parts of the lower boots. Cropped dark arms and bodies intrude from both side edges and upper corners, suggesting opponents close to the viewer without pulling attention from the central fighter. Red embers scatter through the air, especially around the waist and hands, while a pale cloud of dust lifts from the floor beneath the stance. The background stays deep gray and nearly featureless, allowing the silhouette and burning orbs to read immediately. Firelight illuminates the hands, lower sleeves, and front cloth in warm red-orange, while a cooler dim overhead light catches the hat rim and upper armor. The rendering has rough, smoky brush texture around the edges and harder metallic lines at the joints. The overall composition is symmetrical in its paired flames but unsettled by the surrounding figures and drifting sparks, giving the scene forceful suspended motion.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形数字动作插画里，一位蒙面斗士在暗色、近似擂台的空间中双腿大开站立，周围烟雾与火星翻动。宽大的锥形帽遮住头部，人物穿层叠红布与黑灰色护甲。脸几乎完全藏在帽檐下，中央只能看到窄暗面罩与隐约发亮的眼睛。躯干被交叉的红色布片覆盖，腰间束紧，长布条垂向膝部。护肩与护臂向两侧伸出，每只手都托着明亮的橙白火球。圆形火焰位于左右下三分之一附近，围绕中央红色身影形成一对强暖色焦点。双腿分开构成稳定战斗姿势，布料与烟尘遮住靴子部分。被画边截断的深色手臂和身体从两侧与上角伸入，暗示对手靠近观者，却没有夺走中央斗士的注意力。红色余烬散在空气里，尤其靠近腰部和双手，淡色尘云从脚下地面升起。背景保持深灰且几乎没有具体物件，使剪影与燃烧光球立刻可读。火光以暖红橙色照亮手、下臂和前侧布料，较冷的微弱顶光则勾出帽沿与上部盔甲。渲染在边缘带粗糙烟雾笔触，关节处则有更硬的金属线条。整体构图因成对火球而对称，却被周围人物和飘动火星打乱，呈现蓄势待发的动感。
style_prompt_en: The image is a dark digital combat illustration built around one centered silhouette and paired high-intensity glows. Charcoal, black, and deep crimson occupy most of the frame; white-hot orange accents appear in compact circular areas and scatter into fine sparks. Hard armor edges contrast with loose smoky brushwork and drifting dust, making the focal form solid while the surrounding space remains unstable. Warm light radiates locally from the bright accents, and weak cool overhead illumination picks out only upper contours. Cropped peripheral masses press inward, increasing tension and scale without filling the central gap. The overall effect is dramatic, kinetic, and heat-charged.
style_prompt_zh: 图像是一种暗调数字战斗插画，以居中的剪影和成对高亮光团组织。炭灰、黑色与深绯红占据大部分画幅，炽白橙色强调压缩在圆形区域，并散为细小火星。坚硬护甲边缘对照松散的烟雾笔触与漂浮尘埃，使焦点形体牢固，周围空间却不稳定。暖光从亮点局部向外扩散，微弱冷色顶光只勾出上部轮廓。被裁切的边缘体量向内挤压，增加张力和尺度，却没有填满中央空隙。整体效果戏剧化、充满动势和热度。
theme_en: A red-clad masked fighter holding two glowing fireballs
theme_zh: 红衣蒙面斗士双手托着发光火球
name: Mortal Kombat
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
